Ooredoo الجزائر تتضامن مع السكان المتضرر: Ooredoo Algeria stands in solidarity with the populations affected by the forest fires
الجزائر، 30 أوت 2026 ꞉ على إثر الحرائق ا: Algiers, August 30, 2026: Following the fires that affected several wilayas across the country, Ooredoo Algeria expresses its deep solidarity with the affected populations and extends its sincere condolences to the families of the victims.
وفي ظل هذه الظروف الصعبة والمؤلمة، تجدد: In these difficult and painful circumstances, Ooredoo Algeria renews its commitment to contributing to national solidarity efforts by taking concrete initiatives aimed at providing support and assistance to the populations affected by these fires.
وفي هذا الإطار، ووفقًا لتعليمات وزارة ال: In this context, and in accordance with the instructions of the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications, Ooredoo Algeria announces the provision of free calls to all networks and free internet service for seven (7) days for its customers in the wilayas affected by the fires, enabling them to stay in touch with their loved ones and facilitating their communication during this trying period.
وبالتوازي مع ذلك، تعتزم Ooredoo الجزائر: In parallel, Ooredoo Algeria intends to launch several solidarity initiatives for the benefit of the most affected wilayas, to contribute to relief efforts and provide tangible support to the populations affected by the fires.
وبهذه المناسبة، صرح السيد روني طعمه، الم: On this occasion, Mr. Rony Tomeh, General Manager of Ooredoo Algeria, stated: "On my behalf, on behalf of Ooredoo Algeria, and all our employees, I extend my sincere condolences to the families of the victims of these fires, and express our deep sympathy and solidarity. We also extend our condolences to all the people affected by this painful ordeal. In these difficult circumstances, it is our duty as a corporate citizen to stand by our citizens and contribute to the collective efforts being made. The free calls and internet service for seven days in the concerned wilayas, along with the solidarity initiatives we are launching, reflect our desire to provide tangible assistance to the affected populations. Ooredoo Algeria will remain fully committed to standing by citizens and will continue to contribute to solidarity efforts for the benefit of the affected populations."
ومن خلال هذه المبادرات، تجدد Ooredoo الج: Through these initiatives, Ooredoo Algeria renews its steadfast commitment to supporting national solidarity efforts and its eagerness to stand by citizens and support them in circumstances that call for solidarity and cooperation.
